job.question: Which due diligence questionnaire in the corpus asks the manager 'What kills a deal for your team?', and who published it?
job.expected_facts: The Private Markets Due Diligence Questionnaire ('Your Resource for Evaluating Private Market Partners') published by Calamos Investments with Aksia (file AC_Private_Markets). job.acceptance: AC Private Markets / Calamos with Aksia accepted. Subtitle, copyright year and recent-example follow-up are optional.
